description: Returns recent ERC1155 conditional-token (share) transfers on Polymarket. Surfaces whales moving winning positions to fresh wallets to mask PnL, self-shuffling, fresh-wallet drops, and round-trips — all activity that happens off the exchange order book.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for filtering CTF position transfers

flagged_only.description: If true, only return transfers with heuristic flags (whale, self_shuffle, fresh, round_trip)

market_slug.description: Optional: filter to a specific market slug

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

since_hours.description: Only include transfers in the last N hours (default 24)

name: get_position_transfers
